samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_adder">
    <description>A parameterized fixed-point adder for performing addition and subtraction based on the sign of the operands.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">N-bit output representing the result of the fixed-point addition.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <param name="Q">Number of fractional bits (precision).</param>
        <param name="N">Total number of bits, including integer and fractional parts.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]">Register to store the result of the addition or subtraction.</reg>
        
        // Combinational logic for addition/subtraction based on signs of 'a' and 'b'
        always @(*) begin
            if ((a[N-1] == b[N-1])) begin
                res = {a[N-1], a[N-2:0] + b[N-2:0]};
            end else begin
                if (a > b) begin
                    res = {1'b0, a[N-2:0] - b[N-2:0]};
                end else begin
                    res = {1'b1, b[N-2:0] - a[N-2:0]};
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning the result to the output port
        assign c = res;
    </logic_description>
</module>
